name: run_enformer_deepmind_predict
description: Predict genomic tracks from DNA sequence with the OFFICIAL DeepMind Enformer release (the TF-Hub SavedModel deepmind/enformer/1), byte-pinned and verified. Returns the centre-bin value across every track, plus the full 896-bin profile of any track named. Use this when published Enformer numbers must reproduce; use run_enformer_predict (the enformer-pytorch port, GPU) when throughput matters more than matching the authors' artifact. One window costs about three minutes: this release has no GPU-capable build for this machine's architecture and runs on the CPU.

sequence.description: DNA sequence (A, C, G, T, N). Centre-cropped or N-padded to 393,216 bases, of which the model reads the central 196,608. The cost does not depend on the length you send.

organism.description: Which head to read: 'human' has 5,313 tracks, 'mouse' 1,643.

tracks.description: Track indices whose full 896-bin profile to return, at most 32. The centre bin of every track is returned regardless.

centre.description: Centre-bin value for every track of the chosen head.

profiles.description: Full 896-bin profile per requested track index.
